input.content:
Unfortunately, cancellation is all-or-nothing — I can only cancel an entire pending order, not individual items from it. If we cancel the whole order, everything (keyboard, helmet, headphones, office chair, and hiking boots) would be cancelled and the full $1,527.24 refunded to your PayPal within 5–7 business days.

That said, here's what I *can* do on this pending order:
1. Cancel the entire order — you could then place a new order with just the items you still want.
2. Modify item options — swap any item for a different variant of the same product (e.g., a different keyboard switch type or boot size), though I can't remove items entirely.
3. Modify the shipping address or payment method.

Which of those would you like to explore?
